listing_copy.headline: Spacious 4‑Bedroom Home with Pool, Braai & Solar Geyser in Waterkloof Ridge
listing_copy.description: Discover a generous four‑bedroom family residence in Waterkloof Ridge, Pretoria, set on a 1,050 m² block. The 280 m² home offers an open‑plan lounge and dining area with a fireplace, a modern kitchen featuring granite countertops, and a main bedroom with en‑suite and walk‑in closet. Additional amenities include a double garage, staff quarters, a swimming pool, braai area, alarm system, electric fencing, and a solar geyser. Pets are welcome, and the neighbourhood provides parks and several schools within easy reach.
